name: Ollama
description: Connect Meshery to a self-hosted Ollama instance to generate Kubernetes Designs from natural language prompts using locally-run models. No cloud API key is required by default; Ollama instances that sit behind an authenticating proxy can optionally supply a bearer token as a Credential.

registered.description: Confirms the configured Ollama instance is reachable and has at least one model available, and marks this provider ready for Design generation.
Keeps the connection registered but excludes it from the provider list shown during Design generation.

connected.description: Stops using this provider for Design generation. The connection (and credential, if one was supplied) is kept, so it can be reconnected without re-entering configuration.
Removes this connection and any associated credential from Meshery.

disconnected.description: Re-checks reachability of the configured Ollama instance and resumes using this provider for Design generation.
Removes this connection and any associated credential from Meshery.

ignored.description: Re-checks reachability of the configured Ollama instance and resumes using this provider for Design generation.
Removes this connection and any associated credential from Meshery.

baseUrl.title: Ollama Base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Ollama instance Meshery should talk to. Can point at a local, in-cluster, or LAN address. See PR description for the SSRF-trap blocklist applied to this field server-side.

defaultModel.title: Default Model
defaultModel.description: Model tag used for Design generation requests unless overridden per-request. Must already be pulled on the target Ollama instance.

name.title: Connection Name
name.description: Optional friendly name for this connection.

apiKey.title: Bearer Token
apiKey.description: Optional. Only needed if this Ollama instance sits behind an authenticating reverse proxy. Left blank for a typical local/LAN Ollama install. Never written to Connection metadata, generated Designs, logs, or events.
